body.name: Full four-cell finite-bandwidth covariance
body.construction: For each cell, insert the centered kernel tangent in def:nested-derivative to obtain \(\Psi_{g,h}\), retaining the harmonic translation score, both appearances of every control noise, and all within-cell cross products, and set \(\Sigma_h(P)=\log(1/h)^{-1}\sum_{g\in\mathcal G}\rho_g^{-1}\operatorname{Var}_{P_g}(\Psi_{g,h}(X))\).
